host.description: Database host (as seen from where the collector runs).
host.title: Host

user.description: Role to connect as. Use a read-only role.
user.title: User

password.description: Secret reference: `pgpass`, `none`, `env:NAME` or `file:/abs/path` (mode 0600). A literal is a load error.
password.title: Password

sslmode.description: libpq sslmode: disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca or verify-full.
sslmode.title: Sslmode

mode.description: `strict` denies a database write outside an approved plan; `ask` prompts instead of denying.
mode.title: Mode

name.description: Platform name, shown in the generated map.
name.title: Name

map_budget_tokens.description: Token budget for the generated map.md (the file loaded every session).
map_budget_tokens.title: Map Budget Tokens

snapshot_max_age_hours.description: A snapshot older than this is flagged as stale at session start.
snapshot_max_age_hours.title: Snapshot Max Age Hours

retention.description: Number of dated snapshots kept per source.
retention.title: Retention

ScanConfig.description: One static scan (M1c). Paths are relative to the hub. Scanned code is parsed, never imported or run.

type.description: Scanner type: airflow, dbt or sql.
type.title: Type

path.description: Directory to scan, relative to the hub. Parsed, never imported or run.
path.title: Path

project.description: Project name the catalog entries belong to. Default: the scan name.
project.title: Project

util_packages.description: airflow: shared packages whose functions are resolved to their callers.
util_packages.title: Util Packages

dataset_tables.description: airflow: Dataset URI patterns, e.g. `warehouse://{schema}/{table}` (must contain `{table}`).
dataset_tables.title: Dataset Tables

dialect.description: airflow (SQL strings) and sql: sqlglot dialect used to parse SQL.
dialect.title: Dialect

ScanConfig.title: ScanConfig

name.description: Source name, `[a-z0-9_-]+`; used in file names and `dea query <source>`.
name.title: Name

type.description: Collector type: postgres, redshift, airflow, dbt or aws (see docs/collectors.md).
type.title: Type

exec.description: `local`, or `ssh:<host-alias>` to run the collector on another host over ssh.
exec.title: Exec

timeout_seconds.description: Per-collector timeout. Unset: 600 for redshift, 120 otherwise.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

data_api.description: redshift only: Data API target `{cluster_id|workgroup, database, db_user|secret_arn}`.
data_api.title: Data Api

aws.description: aws and redshift: `{profile, region}` or `{instance_role: true}`.
aws.title: Aws

services.description: aws only: which services to read (dms, glue, s3, athena, firehose, cloudwatch) and their options.
services.title: Services

writable.description: postgres only: the role may write. Used by `dea apply` for approved plans, never snapshotted.
writable.title: Writable

options.description: Collector-specific options (airflow, dbt, aws); see docs/collectors.md.
options.title: Options

sources.description: Live systems read by `dea snapshot` (read-only collectors).
sources.title: Sources

scans.description: Code scanned by `dea scan` into the catalog.
scans.title: Scans
